name: Your Auto Shop
facts: This is an auto repair shop app: pick your car, say what's wrong, get a price range, book a time, and track the repair.
Hours in the app: Mon-Fri 8 AM-6 PM, Sat 9 AM-3 PM, closed Sunday.
Booking uses 2-hour arrival windows (like 8-10, 10-12) across the next 7 days.
The exact shop address is sent after your booking is confirmed.
All prices in the app are sample prices; the final quote comes after inspection.
Some services say 'Ask for a quote' because the shop sets the price after a look.
Labor is shown at a sample rate of $95 per hour.
The app works in English and Spanish (EN / ES buttons).
The app has no points, rewards, levels, games, or birthday club.
Step 1 Your car, Step 2 What's wrong, Step 3 Quote, Step 4 Book a time.
You can find your car by year/make/model or by decoding your 17-character VIN.
Safety recall and owner complaint info comes from NHTSA, a U.S. government database.
Scan my car reads check-engine codes with a Bluetooth LE (BLE) OBD-II adapter and is read-only; it never clears codes.
You can also type a code (like P0420) instead of using an adapter.
Codes point to a system, not a guaranteed part; the mechanic gives the final diagnosis.
Safari on iPhone can't use Bluetooth; use the free Bluefy browser on iPhone, or Chrome on Android or a computer.
Tire stock checker accepts sizes like 225/45R17, 225 45 17 or P225/45ZR17.
Job tracker stages: Received, Diagnosing, Waiting on parts, Being worked on, Halfway, Almost done, Ready for pickup.
You can get alerts in the app, by text, or by email when your car is almost done and when it's ready.
Pay with QR methods: Apple Pay, Google Pay, card, Cash App, Zelle, Venmo, PayPal, and pay over time (Affirm / Klarna).
Pay with QR: scan the code, pick how to pay, and your receipt is texted to you.
My Garage saves your cars, recalls, scan history, service history and what's due next, only on your phone.
Your garage, photos and requests stay on your phone; there's no account.
Maintenance reminders: oil about every 5,000 miles or 6 months, tire rotation every 6,000 miles or 6 months, brake check every 12 months.
For Tesla owners, Tesla's manual says rotate tires every 6,250 mi (10,000 km), cabin air filter every 2 years, brake fluid checked every 4 years.
The app never asks for your Tesla password.
Paint code is on the sticker in the driver's door jamb (look for PAINT, C/TR or EXT).
Identify my car from a photo and a 3D model of your car are marked 'coming soon'.
Detailing is offered as an add-on to a repair job.
The app marks the pay screen, texts and emails as a demo; no real payment or message is sent in the demo.
suggested: How do I get a price quote?
How do I book a time?
Can you scan my check-engine light?
Is my tire size in stock?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: The app shows Mon-Fri 8 AM-6 PM, Saturday 9 AM-3 PM, and closed Sunday. Call or text the number in the app if you need to double-check.

qa.q: Are you open right now?
qa.a: The bar at the top of the app tells you if the shop is open now and until what time, or when it opens next.

qa.q: Are you open on Sunday?
qa.a: The app shows the shop closed on Sundays.

qa.q: Are you open on Saturday?
qa.a: Yes, Saturday hours in the app are 9 AM-3 PM.

qa.q: What is your address?
qa.a: For privacy, the exact address is sent to you after your booking is confirmed. The app only shows the general area.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: The app shows only a general area. You'll get the exact address once your booking is confirmed.

qa.q: What is your phone number?
qa.a: The number in the app is (555) 010-0000. Tap 'Call / text' on the home screen to reach the shop.

qa.q: How do I contact the shop?
qa.a: Tap the 'Call / text' button on the home screen. You can also request a job right in the app and track updates there.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff or call the number shown in the app.

qa.q: How does the app work?
qa.a: Pick your car, say what's wrong (or tap it on the car), see a price range, pick a time, and request the job. Then track the repair from your phone.

qa.q: How do I get a quote?
qa.a: Tap 'Build my quote', pick your car, describe the problem or tap a spot on the car, and you'll see an estimated total. Final quote comes after inspection.

qa.q: Are the prices final?
qa.a: No. Prices in the app are sample prices, and the final quote comes after the shop inspects your car.

qa.q: What does 'Ask for a quote' mean?
qa.a: Some services have no price in the app. The shop prices those after taking a look at your car.

qa.q: How much is labor?
qa.a: The app uses a sample labor rate of $95 per hour. Your final price is confirmed after inspection.

qa.q: Is there a trip fee?
qa.a: The app shows no trip fee on estimates. The final quote is confirmed after inspection.

qa.q: How do I pick my car?
qa.a: In Step 1, choose year, make and model. You can also type your make and model, or decode your VIN.

qa.q: How do I use my VIN?
qa.a: Type the 17-character VIN (no I, O or Q) and tap Decode. It fills in your car's details.

qa.q: Where do I find my VIN?
qa.a: I don't have that detail. Check your registration or insurance card, or ask staff.

qa.q: What is the 'More details' section for?
qa.a: You can add engine size, fuel, drivetrain, trim, headlights, ABS and body style. It makes the parts list and what-to-ask script more exact. It's optional.

qa.q: What is the paint code and where is it?
qa.a: It's on the sticker in the driver's door jamb. Look for PAINT, C/TR or EXT. Body shops use it to match paint.

qa.q: Can I add a photo of my car?
qa.a: Yes, tap 'Take or upload a photo of your car.' It's saved only on your phone.

qa.q: Can the app identify my car from a photo?
qa.a: Not yet. That feature, and a 3D model of your car, are marked 'coming soon'.

qa.q: How do I tell you what's wrong?
qa.a: In Step 2, type it in your own words (like 'squeaks when I brake') or tap a glowing spot on the car. Tap 'Find the fix + price'.

qa.q: Can I see the front and back of the car?
qa.a: Yes. Flip between Side, Front and Back. Front and Back show the battery, A/C, other tires and the trunk.

qa.q: What services do you offer?
qa.a: Diagnostics, inspections, brakes, oil change, tires, engine and tune-up, transmission, electrical, battery, A/C and heating, suspension, steering, exhaust, headlights, taillights, wipers, doors and windows, auto glass, and a detailing add-on.

qa.q: Do you do oil changes?
qa.a: Yes. Options include conventional, full synthetic, synthetic blend, high-mileage and diesel oil, plus filters and fluid services. Some are quote-only.

qa.q: Do you do brake work?
qa.a: Yes: brake pads, pads plus rotors, and brake fluid flush. Pads and rotors are priced per axle (front or rear).

qa.q: Do you do tires?
qa.a: Yes: rotate all 4, flat repair, replace one or all 4, balance, mounting, TPMS sensors, alignment and seasonal swaps. Some are quote-only.

qa.q: Do you fix check-engine lights?
qa.a: Yes. Start with a code scan and inspection, or a deeper diagnosis for electrical or no-start problems. You can also scan the codes yourself in the app.

qa.q: Do you do batteries?
qa.a: Yes: battery and charging test, battery replacement, and cleaning terminals.

qa.q: Do you do A/C and heating?
qa.a: Yes: A/C recharge, leak check with UV dye, cabin air filter, heater not warming, blower fan problems, and A/C compressor (quote-only).

qa.q: Do you do transmission work?
qa.a: Yes: diagnosis, fluid and filter service, clutch replacement, leak or seal repair, and rebuild or replace. All are quote-only.

qa.q: Do you do suspension and steering?
qa.a: Yes. Suspension covers shocks, struts, sway bar links, control arms, ball joints and bushings. Steering covers tie rods, power steering pump, steering rack and alignment through a partner shop.

qa.q: Do you do electrical repairs?
qa.a: Yes: alternator, starter, battery drain test, wiring or short repair, fuses and relays, and ground straps or battery cables.

qa.q: Do you do exhaust work?
qa.a: Yes: leak or noise inspection, muffler and pipe repair, O2 sensor, catalytic converter, exhaust manifold and custom exhaust (the last two are quote-only).

qa.q: Do you do inspections or smog checks?
qa.a: Yes, as quote-only options: multi-point, pre-purchase, smog or emissions where required, state safety inspection where required, and road-trip check.

qa.q: Do you do headlights and taillights?
qa.a: Yes: bulb replacement, LED upgrade, headlight restoration, and taillight bulbs or housings.

qa.q: Do you do wipers or windshield work?
qa.a: Yes: wiper blades and washer pump. Auto glass covers chip repair, windshield replacement, side and back glass, and camera recalibration (quote-only).

qa.q: Do you fix power windows and door locks?
qa.a: Yes: window regulator or motor and door lock actuator. These are priced per door.

qa.q: Do you offer detailing?
qa.a: Yes, as an add-on while your car is there: interior detail, wash and wax, and full detail. Paint correction, ceramic coating and more are quote-only.

qa.q: Do you come to my home or work?
qa.a: This version of the app is set up as a drop-off shop. Ask staff or call if you need a mobile visit.

qa.q: Do you do body work or paint?
qa.a: Body and paint aren't listed in this app. Please ask staff or call the number shown.

qa.q: Do you do sound system installs or window tint?
qa.a: They aren't listed in this version of the app. Please ask staff or call the number shown.

qa.q: How do I book a time?
qa.a: Tap 'Pick a time' on your quote, or open Book. Choose a day and tap an open arrival window to hold it, then request the job.

qa.q: How long are the time slots?
qa.a: They're 2-hour arrival windows, like 8-10 and 10-12.

qa.q: How far ahead can I book?
qa.a: The app shows open arrival windows for the next 7 days.

qa.q: What do the Open, Booked and Your pick colors mean?
qa.a: Open windows are free to tap, Booked ones are taken, and Your pick is the one you're holding.

qa.q: What if a day is full or closed?
qa.a: The app tells you 'Closed this day' or 'Fully booked.' Pick another day.

qa.q: What happens after I request a job?
qa.a: The shop accepts it with a final quote. You can follow it in 'My requests' under the job tracker.

qa.q: Do I need to give my name?
qa.a: Your first name is optional when you send a request.

qa.q: What if the shop can't take my job?
qa.a: The tracker will say the shop can't take it. Try another time.

qa.q: Can I copy or text my quote?
qa.a: Yes. Use 'Copy quote' or 'Text quote' to share it.

qa.q: How do I track my car?
qa.a: Open Track. Every update from the shop shows up there, from Received to Ready for pickup.

qa.q: What are the repair stages?
qa.a: Received, Diagnosing, Waiting on parts, Being worked on, Halfway, Almost done, and Ready for pickup.

qa.q: Can I see a sample of the tracker?
qa.a: Yes, tap 'Play the sample' in the tracker to see how updates look.

qa.q: Will I get notified when my car is ready?
qa.a: Yes. Turn on alerts under Alerts: in-app pop-ups, a text, or an email when it's almost done and when it's ready.

qa.q: How do I turn on text or email alerts?
qa.a: Open Alerts, switch on text or email, and enter your mobile number or email.

qa.q: Will the text alerts really send?
qa.a: In the demo nothing is sent. Real texts go live once the texting number is approved by the carriers.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: Use Pay with QR: scan the code, pick how you want to pay, and your receipt is texted to you.

qa.q: What payment methods do you take?
qa.a: The app lists Apple Pay, Google Pay, card (tap or chip), Cash App, Zelle, Venmo, PayPal, and pay over time with Affirm or Klarna.

qa.q: Do you take cash?
qa.a: Cash isn't listed in the app. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Can I pay over time?
qa.a: The app lists 'Pay over time' with Affirm or Klarna as an option.

qa.q: Do I get a receipt?
qa.a: Yes, the pay steps say your receipt is texted to you.

qa.q: Does the pay screen charge me for real?
qa.a: In the demo, no. Nothing is charged and no account is connected.

qa.q: How do I check if my tire size is in stock?
qa.a: Open Tires, type the size from your tire's sidewall, pick how many (1, 2, 4, 5 or 6), and tap 'Check stock'.

qa.q: What tire size formats work?
Where do I find my tire size?
qa.a: It's printed on the side of every tire, like P225/45R17 94V. It's also on the sticker in the driver's door jamb.

qa.q: What do the numbers in a tire size mean?
qa.a: 225 is the width in millimeters, 45 is the sidewall height as a percent of the width, and R17 means it fits a 17-inch wheel.

qa.q: I don't know my tire size.
qa.a: Tap 'Don't know your size? Pick your car' and the app shows your factory size. Or snap a photo of the sidewall and text it to the shop.

qa.q: Can I hold a set of tires?
qa.a: Yes. If your size is in stock you can hold a set, and it's added to your quote.

qa.q: What if my tires aren't in stock?
qa.a: The app says it can order them, usually within about 2-3 business days (a sample timing).

qa.q: Can I filter tires by type?
qa.a: Yes: All-season, Performance, Truck / SUV and Winter.

qa.q: Is the tire stock in the app real?
qa.a: The stock list and brands in the app are samples, so please confirm with the shop.

qa.q: How do I scan my check-engine light?
qa.a: Open Scan. Plug a Bluetooth LE OBD-II adapter into the port under the dash, turn the key to ON, then tap 'Connect & read codes'. Or type a code you already have.

qa.q: Which scan adapter should I buy?
qa.a: The app lists Veepeak OBDCheck BLE+, Vgate iCar Pro BLE 4.0, and OBDLink CX. Get a 'BLE' or 'Bluetooth 4.0' model.

qa.q: Can I use any Bluetooth scanner?
qa.a: No. Classic-Bluetooth and Wi-Fi adapters can't talk to a web page. You need a Bluetooth LE one.

qa.q: Does scanning work on iPhone?
qa.a: Safari on iPhone can't use Bluetooth. Open the page in the free Bluefy browser, or type the code instead. Chrome on Android and computers works.

qa.q: Will the scan erase my codes?
qa.a: No. The scan is read-only and never clears codes.

qa.q: I don't have an adapter. Can I still look up a code?
qa.a: Yes. Type the code (like P0420) and tap 'Look up'. Most parts stores can read a code for free too.

qa.q: Can I try the scan without an adapter?
qa.a: Yes, tap 'Try a demo scan.' It uses sample data, not your car.

qa.q: Does a code tell me exactly what part to replace?
qa.a: No. Codes point to a system, not a guaranteed part. The mechanic makes the final diagnosis.

qa.q: Can I add the scan result to my quote?
qa.a: Yes. Tap 'Add to my job' on a code to add the likely fix to your quote.

qa.q: Does the scanner work on electric cars?
qa.a: EVs report few generic engine codes. Teslas don't use the standard port for owner scans, so write down any alert on the screen (Controls > Service) and type it in or tell the shop.

qa.q: What is My Garage?
qa.a: It saves your cars with their recalls, scan history, service history and what's due next. It lives only on your phone.

qa.q: How do I save my car?
qa.a: After picking your car, tap 'Save to My Garage'.

qa.q: What maintenance reminders does the app show?
qa.a: Oil change, tire rotation and brake check. The app's rules of thumb are oil every 5,000 miles or 6 months, rotation every 6,000 miles or 6 months, and brakes every 12 months. Your owner's manual wins.

qa.q: Can I see recalls for my car?
qa.a: Yes. Once you pick year, make and model, the app shows NHTSA safety recalls and the most-reported owner complaints.

qa.q: How much does a recall repair cost?
qa.a: The app says recall repairs are a free fix at a dealer. Not every car is affected; enter your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to check yours.

qa.q: Are owner complaints confirmed defects?
qa.a: No. They're owner reports filed with NHTSA, not confirmed defects.

qa.q: Do you have tips for Tesla owners?
qa.a: Yes. Many Tesla recalls are fixed by free over-the-air updates, so keep the car on Wi-Fi. Tesla's manual says rotate tires every 6,250 mi, cabin air filter every 2 years, and check brake fluid every 4 years.

qa.q: Does the app ask for my Tesla password?
qa.a: No. It never asks for your Tesla password. Live battery and software info is marked 'coming later'.

qa.q: Does the app have a rewards program or points?
qa.a: No. This app has no points, rewards, levels, referrals or birthday club.

qa.q: Are there games or contests?
qa.a: No. This app has no games, weekly contests or leaderboards.

qa.q: Do you have specials or discounts?
qa.a: I don't have any specials or discounts listed. Ask staff or call the number shown.

qa.q: Can I order food or use a table QR code?
qa.a: No, this is an auto shop app. The only QR code is for paying the shop.

qa.q: Is the app in Spanish?
qa.a: Yes. Tap ES at the top to switch to Spanish, or EN for English.

qa.q: Can I install the app on my phone?
qa.a: I don't have install steps. Ask staff for help adding it to your home screen.

qa.q: Is my information private?
qa.a: Your garage, photos and requests are saved only on your phone, with no account. In the demo, nothing is sent anywhere.

qa.q: Does the app use my location?
qa.a: I don't have any location feature listed for this shop. The exact address is sent after your booking is confirmed.

qa.q: What if I need to talk to a person?
qa.a: Tap 'Call / text' on the home screen, or call the number shown in the app.

qa.q: Where does the car and VIN info come from?
qa.a: Make, model and VIN data come from NHTSA vPIC, a free U.S. government database. Specs come from the U.S. EPA / DOE (fueleconomy.gov).

qa.q: What is the exploded-view diagram?
qa.a: It's an illustration of your car's parts that you can zoom. It's for reference only, not a factory diagram, and the numbers drawn in it aren't checked. Use the verified specs listed next to it. For some models it's marked 'coming soon'.

qa.q: Will the parts list tell me exact part numbers?
qa.a: No. Parts shown are typical for the job, and your mechanic confirms exact part numbers after inspection.

qa.q: Do you offer before and after photos?
qa.a: The app has a before/after slider, but the current images are placeholder sample art.
